typical_complaints: EVERY Level 1 or Level 2 patient, whatever the complaint

fever (suspected viral/dengue/malaria/typhoid without warning signs), cold and cough, acute chest infection/pneumonia, gastritis/acidity, loose motions, jaundice, urine burning (not pregnant), anaemia/weakness, diabetes and BP problems, headache, thyroid, medicine refills, follow-up, certificates
children under 12 years with medical complaints (fever, cough/cold, fast breathing, wheeze, diarrhoea/vomiting, jaundice, worms, constipation) and all infants under 3 months
pregnancy check-ups and pregnancy-related complaints, urine burning in pregnancy, vaginal discharge, period problems, lower-abdominal pain with fever/discharge, contraception, infertility
cuts and wounds, boils/abscesses, cellulitis, diabetic foot, dog bites, appendicitis-type pain, kidney-stone pain, gall-bladder pain, urine retention, hernia, piles, breast lump
back/neck/shoulder/knee pain, sprains, suspected fractures, chest-wall injury
ear pain/discharge/blocked ear, sore throat/tonsils as the main complaint, nose bleeds, foreign body in ear/nose
refractive error/glasses, cataract, red eye, foreign body in eye
itching/scabies, ringworm, eczema, acne, white patches, hives without breathing problems, numb skin patch
anxiety, sleep problems, low mood, alcohol withdrawal (mild)
toothache, gum bleeding while brushing, dental swelling, wisdom tooth
stable breathlessness on exertion with leg swelling (heart failure), recurrent palpitations that have settled
cough for more than 2 weeks / suspected TB, TB on treatment, asthma or COPD (adults and children 12+), inhaler refills
